title: app-sso-google data payload
description: Data payload for the app-sso-google Forge-native task. Sends the Google Workspace SSO setup email to the ticket POC, posts a confirmation comment with the [app-sso-google] setup-sent marker, and transitions the ticket from BACKLOG to INITIAL_CONTACT. Forge-native: reads/writes via Forge API, never touches Jira.

sso_type.description: The SSO type the skill targeted. Always 'GOOGLE_SAML' for this skill (kept in the payload for symmetry with app-api's provider field and to support future variant skills).

sso_type_source.description: Where the SSO type was sourced from. Always 'skill_default' for app-sso-google unless an override is supplied.

declined_reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is wrong_type / declined.

routing_suggestion.description: If declined due to wrong_type, a hint about who should handle it instead.

missing.description: Field names that need human input when status is needs_input.

note.description: Free-form explanation accompanying a non-ok status.

prior_run.description: Populated when status is already_sent. Extracted from the prior [app-sso-google] setup-sent marker comment.

reason.description: Short machine-readable reason tag when email was not sent (e.g. missing_poc_email, already_sent).

sso_type_ticket.description: SSO type as recorded on the ticket (ssoTypeApp), for audit.

gmail_thread_id.description: Gmail threadId of the sent message. Join key for inbound reply matching.

gmail_message_id.description: Gmail message id of the sent message.

skill_version.description: Version of the skill that produced this result.

dry_run.description: Whether this run was a dry run (no side effects).

triggered_by.description: Email of the operator who triggered the run, if known.
